lineage.strategy: Prioritize realized regulatory/technical execution milestones rather than forward commercial claims.

observations.fact: DOE Idaho Operations approved the Preliminary Documented Safety Analysis for the Aurora powerhouse at Idaho National Laboratory, covering hazard analysis, accident analysis, safety controls and design commitments under the Reactor Pilot Program.
Oklo's newsroom records that the Groves reactor achieved first criticality on August 6, 2026, following DOE startup authorization and final safety analysis milestones in July.

risks.risk: Pilot/reactor milestones do not establish commercial Aurora licensing, on-time customer delivery, realized power revenue or project economics.

unknowns.unknown: Commercial Aurora commissioning schedule, realized capex per MW, operating cost and contracted power economics remain unproven by these milestones.

recommendation: Use as strong regulatory/technical execution evidence while keeping commercial economics and Aurora delivery timing explicitly unknown.
